audit.whatIsWrong: The TL;DR, win condition, dosFull[1] and wants.you[1] all built the gameplan around Wind Wall — 'Wind Wall his sapling toss', 'block his saplings', 'save Wind Wall for the follow-up'.
audit.why: Not one ability in Maokai's kit carries the projectile flag. Bramble Smash (Q) is a shockwave around him, Twisted Advance (W) is a targeted dash, Sapling Toss (E) is a placed zone, and Nature's Grasp (R) is advancing terrain. Wind Wall has no target in this matchup at all — telling the user to hold a 25s cooldown for a block that cannot happen loses them the lane.
audit.corrected: Nothing he casts is a projectile; Wind Wall does nothing here. The lane is played on range discipline and the Twisted Advance cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sapling Toss was labelled (W) in three fields and 'his Q saplings' in a fourth; wants.you[0] and spikes[0] told the user to dodge Twisted Advance with a dash.
audit.why: Sapling Toss is his E (1100 range, 18s at rank 1). Twisted Advance is his W and is TARGETED — Riot's text has him become untargetable and dash to the target, rooting on arrival. There is nothing to sidestep once it is cast, and he cannot be hit mid-dash either. The answer is range: it is 525, so the discipline is to not be inside it.
audit.corrected: Sapling Toss (E), Twisted Advance (W), targeted and untargetable — stay outside 525 and trade in its 14s gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were given to Yasuo and level 1 called even; first item given to Yasuo.
audit.why: Mirror chart: Level 1 Yasuo, Levels 2-3 Maokai, Levels 4-5 / 6 / first item Skill, 2+ items Yasuo. Level 1 he has only a slow sapling; from 2 his targeted root and Sap Magic sustain take over, and at first item his healing offsets your crit spike.
audit.corrected: Rows: Yasuo, Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yasuo — matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared beside any spike claim.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s, Sapling Toss 18s at rank 1, Nature's Grasp 130s at rank 1. Those are the windows the whole lane is played around.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[1].why, phases[5].why, dosFull[1].d, report[1].t, report[5].t and winCon.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling early is right here — Sap Magic (P) heals him on the empowered attack and its cooldown shortens every time he casts or is hit by a spell, so a Yasuo trading constantly accelerates his own sustain.
audit.corrected: Reinforced in phases[5].why rather than duplicated in itemization.

notes: The headline problem was that this page sold Wind Wall as the answer to a champion with zero projectiles, and told the user to dodge a targeted lock-on root with a dash. Both were on the TL;DR and the win condition, i.e. the two lines a loading screen actually shows. packet.suspectNames flagged 'His Nature's Grasp' and 'Land Twisted Advance' — both FALSE POSITIVES, those are the real R and W names; the real name errors were the slot letters on Sapling Toss. Also note Bramble Smash (Q) carries a 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support (it says only knock back and slow), so I made no grounding claim from it.
